title: What it takes to ship an onchain credit card to non-crypto users
description:
DeFi assumes users who understand wallets, gas, and liquidations. Most people don't, and building for them means solving problems that have little to do with smart contracts: how accounts get created and recovered, how risk gets explained, what happens when a payment goes wrong, and how much of the underlying chain users should see at all.
 
The session goes through each of these problems, the common approaches to solving them, and which ones hold up in production. Examples are drawn from an onchain credit card used by non-crypto customers, including data on where users struggled and what changed as a result.
